[[Estadio Benito Villamarín]] (Real Betis) | pushpin_map = Spain Seville | coordinates1 = {{coord|37.356389|-5.981389|display=inline}} | pushpin_mark1 = Green pog.svg | pushpin_label1 = '''Real Betis''' | pushpin_label1_position = right | coordinates2 = {{coord|37.384|-5.9705|display=inline}} | pushpin_mark2 = Red pog.svg | pushpin_label2 = '''Sevilla''' | pushpin_label2_position = left }} The '''Seville derby''' (''Derbi Sevillano''), also known as '''The Great Derby'''{{Cite news |last=Tur |first=Carlos |date=12 April 2019 |title=De cómo (y por qué) el derbi sevillano se convirtió en ElGranDerbi |trans-title=How (and why) the Seville derby became TheGreatDerby |url=https://eldesmarque.com/sevilla/no-es-futbol-es-laliga/1150554-el-gran-derbi |language=Spanish |work=ElDesmarque.com |location=Seville |access-date=23 July 2019 |archive-date=23 July 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190723214248/https://eldesmarque.com/sevilla/no-es-futbol-es-laliga/1150554-el-gran-derbi |url-status=dead }} (''El Gran Derbi''), is the name of a local city derby located in [[Seville]], Spain contested between [[Real Betis]] and [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]]. Sevilla FC were founded in 1890.{{Cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/nationalassociations/teams/52714--sevilla/|title=Sevilla|website=[[UEFA]].com|publisher=Union of European Football Associations|access-date=21 August 2018}} This was followed in September 1907 by the city's second club 'Sevilla Balompié'. Following an internal split from Sevilla FC another club was formed, Betis Football Club. 1914 saw the culmination of a merger between Betis Football Club and Sevilla Balompié. With the patronage title, the club became Real Betis Balompié. On 8 October 1915, the first Seville derby took place, a 4–3 Sevilla victory. The first competitive derby between the sides took place on 19 February 1928, in a [[1928 Copa del Rey|Copa del Rey]] game. Sevilla are located in the richer [[Nervión, Seville|Nervión district]] of Seville and play at the [[Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán Stadium|Estadio Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán]] while Real Betis play in the Heliopolis region at the [[Estadio Benito Villamarín]] and are backed more by the working class. ==Honours== {| class="wikitable" style="font-size: 11px; width:100%;" |- ! rowspan=2 style="width:7%;"| Competition ! colspan=2 style="width:25%;"| [[Real Betis]] ! colspan=2 style="width:25%;"| [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]] |- ! style="width:2%;"| Total ! style="width:23%;"| Seasons ! style="width:2%;"| Total ! style="width:23%;"| Seasons |- | style="text-align: center"|[[La Liga|Primera
